intermittent pool beds are permanent cyclic habitats with distinct wet, moist and dry phases, and that these phases are characterized by unique and persistent macroinvertebrate assemblages.

i) macroinvertebrate assemblages within the terrestrial phase of intermittent pool beds are distinct from those of permanently terrestrial habitats, ii) the aquatic and terrestrial phases of intermittent pool habitats have distinct communities, and iii) the aquatic and the terrestrial phases have strong resource linkages.
